rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark, twisty little passageway in a maze designed to confuse
and frustrate the impatient adventurer.  The walls here are made of highly
polished black ebonstone but they seem to absorb the light in this area
rather than reflect it.  From here a long passageway leads off to the south
and another little hallway branches to the east.

rooms.name: Near Total Darkness
rooms.desc:
It is extremely dark here; you can just barely see the items in your
inventory.  The walls of black ebonstone seem to be absorbing nearly all
the light in this room.  Carefully, you feel around searching for exits.
There seems to be a passage leading south from here, another seems to lead
westward, and there is yet a third opening in the eastern wall.  As you stand
here, trying to choose your path, you catch a faint, putrid smell coming from
the east.

rooms.name: Total Darkness
rooms.desc:
It is extremely dark here.  The walls and ceiling here seem to absorb almost
all the light in this room.  Groping around in the darkness, you feel a
exits to the south and west.  It smells very bad here, like rancid, rotten
flesh... the smell seems to be coming from the south.

rooms.name: Buried Alive?!
rooms.desc:
The world spins and you slowly lose consciousness.  When you awake you find
yourself trapped in a very small, very dark area -- your light does little
to illuminate your cell as the stone that imprison you devour the light
As you feel around you realize, to your horror, that there are no exits
from this claustrophobic little nightmare.  There is no use in screaming
but you do it anyway, until the air runs out in the room, that is.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
This is a small, dark passage that threatens to confuse you with its numerous
twists and turns.  The walls of black ebonstone are highly polished and your
torchlight reflects off them brilliantly.  The floor is made of hard, rough
stone.  This passage continues southward into the darkness.  As you look
down the passage leading west, a urgent feeling of dread paralyzes you!

rooms.name: Labyrinth Chamber
rooms.desc:
This is a medium-sized, circular room with walls of black ebonstone and a
low ceiling.  A thick gas turns and swirls slowly in the cold air here and
chokes you as you try to breathe.  Strange runes have been carved into the
walls here, they seem to glow faintly.  Passages lead southward and
eastward.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a twisty, dimly-lit passage that was designed to confuse the
unwary adventurer.  Just beyond your field of vision, in the deep shadows,
you see something move... or did you imagine that?  Exits in all directions
but up and down.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passage
rooms.desc:
This is a small, dark passage that threatens to confuse you with its numerous
twists and turns.  The walls of black ebonstone are highly polished and your
torchlight reflects off them brilliantly.  The floor is made of hard, rough
stone.  One hallway leads north from here and another veers off to the west.

rooms.name: Demon Imp's Abode
rooms.desc:
This little room is bathed in long, deep shadows and littered with corpses
in various state of decay.  Bones lie strewn about the floor and a nasty,
greenish-black fog swirls lazily in the air and makes you think you see
movement in the shadows.  A dark passageway leads northward.  A black door
hangs on the southern wall.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a small, confusing hallway.  Although you try to resist, you find
yourself growing tired, dizzy and frustrated.  Although you carry a light
source, the walls here seem to absorb much of the light in this room; it is
very difficult to see here.  Exits lead east, south and north but, as you
look into the darkness north of here, a powerful feeling of terror
overwhelms you and you have difficulty maintaining your calm.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark, twisty little passageway in a maze designed to confuse
and frustrate the impatient adventurer.  The walls here are made of highly
polished black ebonstone but they seem to absorb the light in this area
rather than reflect it.  Exits lead north, south, and west.

rooms.name: Dead End
rooms.desc:
You have come to a dead end in the labyrinth.  This passageway abruptly ends
here, the way to the north blocked by a massive wall of black marble.  The
only exit is back to the south.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark, twisty little passageway in a maze designed to confuse
and frustrate the impatient adventurer.  The walls here are made of highly
polished black ebonstone but they seem to absorb the light in this area
rather than reflect it.  This hallway continues to the north and south but
another passage leads off in an eastwardly direction.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:

yourself growing tired, dizzy and frustrated.  Although you carry a light
source, the walls here seem to absorb much of the light in this room; it is
very difficult to see here.  This hallway continues to the north and south,
another passage branches off to the west.

rooms.name: Dead End
rooms.desc:
You have come to a dead end in the labyrinth.  This passageway abruptly ends
here, the way to the north blocked by a massive wall of black marble.  The
only exit is back to the south.

rooms.name: Portal Room
rooms.desc:
This is a large, elegant room.  Pillars of black ebonstone support the high
ceiling and the walls are covered in strange markings.  On the north wall
there is a large door, to the east there is a flickering, glowing portal,
and to the west there is another magic portal.  An inscription on the
southern wall catches your eye.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a twisty, dimly-lit passage that was designed to confuse the
unwary adventurer.  Just beyond your field of vision, in the deep shadows,
you see something move... or did you imagine that?  There are exits to the
north and south.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:

unwary adventurer.  Just beyond your field of vision, in the deep shadows,
you see something move... or did you imagine that?  Exits lead to the north,
east, and south.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
This is a small, dark passage that threatens to confuse you with its numerous
twists and turns.  The walls of black ebonstone are highly polished and your
torchlight reflects off them brilliantly.  The floor is made of hard, rough
stone.  This hallway turns sharply offering an exit to the north and another
to the west.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a twisty, dimly-lit passage that was designed to confuse the
unwary adventurer.  Just beyond your field of vision, in the deep shadows,
you see something move... or did you imagine that?  You may go either north
or east from here.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
This is a small, dark passage that threatens to confuse you with its numerous
twists and turns.  The walls of black ebonstone are highly polished and your
torchlight reflects off them brilliantly.  The floor is made of hard, rough
stone.  Two passages intersect here and you can go in any cardinal direction.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark, twisty little passageway in a maze designed to confuse
and frustrate the impatient adventurer.  The walls here are made of highly
polished black ebonstone but they seem to absorb the light in this area
rather than reflect it.  This cooridoor leads both north and south; another
passageway opens to the west.

rooms.name: Falling...
rooms.desc:
You nimbly slide over the lip of the pit and begin to scale down the smooth
sides.  After about two minutes you realize it was a big mistake -- the
sides of the pit are very hot and offer very little to grab onto.  Ouch,
you lose your grip and plummet towards the bottom, miles below.  Mercifully
you pass out before your body is shattered on sharp rocks and consumed by the
fires of the underworld.

rooms.name: In Furnace Room
rooms.desc:
This vast room is some kind of furnace.  A large, deep pit has been drilled
deep into the ground; indeed, it is so deep that the bottom is lost in
shadow.  Waves of superhot air rush up from the underworld and into this
room -- it is so hot here that your skin is beginning to sting.  At the
top of the chamber there are large conduits which, presumably, bring the
hot air up to the top levels of the tower.  While you could certainly
climb down the pit, it looks difficult and very unsafe; the sides are very hot
and smooth.  A small passageway leads east.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in an intersection in the labyrinth.  A dark, twisty little passage
leads north and south from this point.  To the east another hallway
continues into the darkness.  West of here there seems to be a large room...
it is very warm here...

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a small, confusing hallway.  Although you try to resist, you find
yourself growing tired, dizzy and frustrated.  Although you carry a light
source, the walls here seem to absorb much of the light in this room; it is
very difficult to see here.  Converging passages offer you exits in any
cardinal direction.

rooms.name: Dead End
rooms.desc: This is a dead end in the labyrinth, the only exit is to the west.

rooms.name: Dead End
rooms.desc:
You have come to a dead end in the labyrinth.  This passageway abruptly ends
here, the way to the north blocked by a massive wall of black marble.  The
only exit is back to the south.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a twisty, dimly-lit passage that was designed to confuse the
unwary adventurer.  Just beyond your field of vision, in the deep shadows,
you see something move... or did you imagine that?  While this passageway
continues both north and south, another cooridoor leads off to the east.

rooms.name: The world spins for a moment, then the feeling passes.
rooms.desc:
Labyrinth Passageway
You are in a small, twisty passage in a strange, magical maze.  Four
passages intersect here and you may go north, south, east or west.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Chamber
rooms.desc:
This is a medium-sized, circular room with walls of black ebonstone and a
low ceiling.  A thick gas turns and swirls slowly in the cold air here and
chokes you as you try to breathe.  Strange runes have been carved into the
walls here, they seem to glow faintly.  Passages lead southward and
westward.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:

twists and turns.  The walls of black ebonstone are highly polished and your
torchlight reflects off them brilliantly.  The floor is made of hard, rough
stone.  This passage continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passage
rooms.desc:
This is a small, dark passage that threatens to confuse you with its numerous
twists and turns.  The walls of black ebonstone are highly polished and your
torchlight reflects off them brilliantly.  The floor is made of hard, rough
stone.  This passage continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: Dead End
rooms.desc:
This is a dead end in the labyrinth; the way north is blocked by a high,
strong wall.  The only exit is back south.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are walking down a long, twisty hallway deep within a maze of confusing
turns and magic teleporters.  This hallway twists sharply at one point and
connects with another leading northward.  To the east, it hits another dark
cooridoor.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark, twisty little passageway in a maze designed to confuse
and frustrate the impatient adventurer.  The walls here are made of highly
polished black ebonstone but they seem to absorb the light in this area
rather than reflect it.  Two passages intersect here, one leads north-south
and the other runs east and west.  You may go in any cardinal direction.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a small, confusing hallway.  Although you try to resist, you find
yourself growing tired, dizzy and frustrated.  Although you carry a light
source, the walls here seem to absorb much of the light in this room; it is
very difficult to see here.  This cooridoor leads north-south, an opening
on the western wall seems to lead into another passageway.

rooms.name: You feel yourself yanked by a powerful magic force!
rooms.desc:
Labyrinth Passageway
You are in a dark, twisty little passage in a confusing and frustrating
maze.  Exits lead both north and east.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark, twisty little passageway in a maze designed to confuse
and frustrate the impatient adventurer.  The walls here are made of highly
polished black ebonstone but they seem to absorb the light in this area
rather than reflect it.  Two passages intersect here, one leads north-south
and the other runs east and west.  You may go in any cardinal direction.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a twisty, dimly-lit passage that was designed to confuse the
unwary adventurer.  Just beyond your field of vision, in the deep shadows,
you see something move... or did you imagine that?  Another hallway crosses
this one here, leaving exits to the north, south, east and west.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a small, confusing hallway.  Although you try to resist, you find
yourself growing tired, dizzy and frustrated.  Although you carry a light
source, the walls here seem to absorb much of the light in this room; it is
very difficult to see here.  Exits lead north and west.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
This is a small, dark passage that threatens to confuse you with its numerous
twists and turns.  The walls of black ebonstone are highly polished and your
torchlight reflects off them brilliantly.  The floor is made of hard, rough
stone.  You can continue both north and east from this point.
You sense an evil presence watching you from afar.

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You feel slightly disoriented as you wander through this maze of corridors,
which continue to the north and to the west.

rooms.name: Northern End of Entry Hall
rooms.desc:
This is a large, ornate hallway with highly polished walls of fine, black
ebonstone and a high, vaulted ceiling.  A deep-red carpet leads south, to
the other end of this large room, and matching tapestries of the finest silk
hang here on the blackened walls.  Three crystal doors are set into the
walls here; a beautiful door of crimson crystal lies to the north, a large
door of ebony crystal is set in the western wall, and a glowing door of
white, gleaming crystal hangs on the eastern wall.  The hall continues to
the south.

rooms.name: You feel very dizzy and confused for an instant...
rooms.desc:
Labyrinth Passageway
You are in a cold, dark cooridoor that continues to the north and east.
Although it is very dark here, you can see that both exits lead to passages
remarkably like this one!

rooms.name: Labyrinth Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark, twisty little passageway in a maze designed to confuse
and frustrate the impatient adventurer.  The walls here are made of highly
polished black ebonstone but they seem to absorb the light in this area
rather than reflect it.  A larger passageway leads north into the darkness,
another continues to the west.

rooms.name: Southern End of Entry Hall
rooms.desc:
This is a regal, vast hallway with beautiful walls of polished ebonstone and
a tall, vaulted ceiling.  A rich, deep-red carpeting continues northward, to
the other end of this large hall.  The elegant, vivid tapestries that adorn
the walls here appear to be made of fine silk and have been embroidered with
golden thread.  The hallway continues to the north and, on the southern
wall, there is a massive ebonstone gate.

rooms.name: Servants' Room
rooms.desc:
This room is very small and cold.  A solitary window has been cut into the
northern wall, and two beds are arranged parallel to each other, on
opposite sides of the room.  It does not look as if very many servants could
live here comfortably, but most of the Dark Mage's slaves are magically
created creatures which need no rest anyway.  The only exit is to the south.

rooms.name: Large Study
rooms.desc:
This is a beautifully appointed, comfortable study.  A bright, warm fire
flickers in the stone fireplace even though it has no apparent fuel.  Books
cover the walls; sets of magic tomes arranged carefully and meticuliously.
The large, expensive mahogany writing desk sitting in the center of the room
is empty right now.  The only exit is to the south.

rooms.name: The Baths
rooms.desc:
This large chamber is very steamy and hot.  Three large tubs made from fine
grey marble are set in the ground here, full of steaming hot water.  The
floor of black stone has been left very rough so that bathers do not slip
and hurt themselves.  A strange magical orb hangs suspended near the ceiling
and there is a large chest on the western wall.  The only exit is to the
south, to the hallway.

rooms.name: The Marble Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a wondrous hallway somewhere inside the tower.  Huge pillars of
blackened marble hold up a high ceiling.  The floor here is tiled in with
squares of different colored marble arranged in a pattern.  Breath taking
artwork decorates the walls here and a fine, crystal window is set in the
north wall.  The hall continues both east and south from here.

rooms.name: The Marble Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is an immense hallway all done in marble.  Large ionic columns stretch
up to the ceiling, far above and the floor is a meandering pattern of many
marble tiles.  The walls are made of highly polished black marble that
shines as it reflects your light.  Neatly arranged around the hallway are
colorful paintings framed with grey marble.  A small room lies north of
here, the hallway continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Marble Hallway
rooms.desc:
Your footsteps resound against the marble tiled floor and echo through this
glorious hallway.  The ceiling, high overhead, is supported by thick, ionic
pillars and the walls here are made of highly polished black marble.  A
large metal sculpture dominates the center of this room.  The hallway itself
continues both east and west while a small door leads northward.

rooms.name: The Marble Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a grand, beautiful hallway done completely in fine
marble.  Strong, thick columns reach from the tiled floor up to the heavy
ceiling far above.  Modern art adorns the walls here and a small doorway
leads northward.  The hallway itself continues east and west.

rooms.name: The Marble Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is the most beautiful part of the marble hallway.  On the floor is a
geometric meandering pattern of grey, white and black marble tiles, but the
walls to the north and east are made of pure, transparent crystal.  The
marble hall leads to the west and another hallway begins just south of here.

rooms.name: The Northern Side of the Reflecting Pool
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the reflecting pool; the water comes up to your knees.
To the south is the center of the reflecting pool; thick ebonstone walls
impede your progress in any other direction.  This water is ice cold and
your feet are beginning to feel numb.

rooms.name: Northern End of the Great Library
rooms.desc:
This is the legendary library of the Dark Mage -- largest collection of
knowledge in the know world.  Books line every wall, from the floor to
the ceiling high above.  Sliding ladders are available for the retrieval
of books from the topmost shelves.  Books on every topic are housed here,
some are ancient manuscripts from lost ages which have not survived anywhere
else.  The library continues as far as the eye can see south of here.  A
small doorway in the eastern wall leads out of the library.

rooms.name: Western Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hallway is small and cozy, the walls made of fine ebonstone and trimmed
with white plaster.  A plaster sculpture of a dryad stares at you with
beautiful eyes from atop a plaster pedestal.  To the north the hallway dead
ends into a larger, grander hall, west of here is a small doorway and to
the south the western hallway continues into the darkness.

rooms.name: The Western Side of the Reflecting Pool
rooms.desc:
You are up to your knees in frigid water!  You are standing in the
reflecting pool, at the western side.  East of here is the center of the
pool, your progress in any other direction is blocked by thick ebonstone
walls.

rooms.name: The Center of the Reflecting Pool
rooms.desc:
The water here is deeper than at the sides of the pool, it comes up to your
waist.  The water, which had been still when you decided to take a swim,
has begun to churn and swirl.  The pool gets shallower to the north, south
and west and you can climb out altogether by proceeding to the east.  The
longer you stand here the colder this water becomes, you are beginning to
feel very uncomfortable.

rooms.name: Near the Reflecting Pool
rooms.desc:
You are on a large platform just east of a large pool of still water.  The
water does not appear to be very deep but it is so cold that you feel a
chill just standing near it.  Powerful runes have been scorched into the
pool itself and you assume that this pool is used as a divining aide by
the Dark Mage on occasion.  By going west you can wade out into the pool,
there is another exit to the east.

rooms.name: Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a small, comfortable hallway with stained, wooden panels and thick,
brown carpeting.  A large portrait hangs on the northern wall and there
appears to be a room to the west, through a high archway.  The hall itself
continues both to the south and to the east.

rooms.name: Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a comfortable, well-decorated hallway with fine wood paneling on the
walls and a thick carpeting on the floor.  On the northern wall, in an
elegant frame, there is a skillfully painted portrait.  You seem to be at a
T-intersection; to the south, under a high arch, is a dark room, the hallway
itself continues both east and west.

rooms.name: Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a small, elegantly-appointed hallway with beautifully stained
wooden paneling on the walls and a thick carpet on the floor.  On the
eastern wall there is a small doorway.  To the south and west, the
hall continues.

rooms.name: Small Study
rooms.desc:
This appears to be a small, private study, a single shelf has been mounted
on the wall above a crude, heavy desk.  There are no windows and the only
exit is to the east.

rooms.name: The Eastern Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a medium sized, cozy hallway.  The walls are made of polished black
ebonstone trimmed with fine white plaster.  Small, circular pillars are here
more for effect than function, it would seem.  Beneath a plaster arch, to
the east, there seems to be another room.  The hallway continues to the
south but to the north it seems to empty into a much larger hall.

rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This room is full of exotic fruits and rare vintages.  The wonderful smell
of freshly baked bread wafts through the air, reminding you of the bakery
in town and making your mouth water.  There is a door to the south and one
to the west.

rooms.name: The Southern Side of the Reflecting Pool
rooms.desc:
You are standing knee-deep in the frigid water of the reflecting pool.  To
the north of here, in the center of the pool, the water slightly deeper.
Your way to the south, east and west is blocked by tall, black walls.

rooms.name: In the Great Library
rooms.desc:
You are near the center of the legendary Great Library -- largest collection
of books in the known world.  There are small tables around the area for
studying and sturdy wooden ladders that are used to retrieve books from
shelves too high to reach unaided.  The Dark Mage has all manner of books
in his collection, antiquarian and contemporary.  It is rumored that there
are ancient manuscripts from forgotten ages that have survived no where else
but inside this mystical tower.  The library continues both south and north
from here.

rooms.name: The Western Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in the Western Hallway.  The walls here, like many other places
around the tower, are made of fine ebonstone.  Skillfully cast white plaster
is used as trim around the hallway.  From atop a pedestal a sculpture of the
god Marek stares down at you, majestic power reflected in his eyes.  The
hallway continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a small, private hallway deep inside the tower.  The walls, which
are surely made of ebonstone, have been completely covered over by elegantly
stained mahogany panels and the hard floor is covered by a plush carpeting.
The hallway itself leads north and south into the darkness.

rooms.name: The Portal Room
rooms.desc:
You are in a large, spartan room with a very high ceiling and walls of fine
ebonstone.  To the south there is a flickering, glowing portal which will
surely magically teleport you somewhere else.  To the north an ebon archway
leads into darkness.

rooms.name: Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a small, cozy hallway with fine panels of stained mahogany on the
walls and a thick, comfortable carpeting over the cold stone floor.  A large
portrait has been framed on the eastern wall.  The hallway leads north and
south.

rooms.name: The Eastern Hallway
rooms.desc:
The reflective walls of black ebonstone and the carefully made plaster
pillars give this hallway a regal ambiance.  A large picture has been
framed and hung on the western wall and the hallway itself continues
both to the north and south.

rooms.name: The Northern Dining Room
rooms.desc:
This is a truly wonderful room -- the crystal tables and chairs are very
nice but the view is what makes this room special.  The entire eastern wall
has been turned transparent, and the view is remarkable.  Although you can
see leaves blown by a strong wind, the air here is still and warm.  The
dining area extends to the south and a small door leads north into an
adjacent room.

rooms.name: Northern End of the Statue Gardens
rooms.desc:
You are in a very odd room; exotic plants and trees grow from soily ground
here even though you are inside the tower still.  Far above your head, you
see that the ceiling has been made of some transparent substance and allows
light to feed the plants during the day.  A small path leads southward.

rooms.name: Southern End of the Great Library
rooms.desc:
You are surrounded by books.  This is the southern end of the Dark Mage's
Great Library, the largest collection of knowledge in the known world.
Books literally line every wall, from floor to ceiling.  To the north,
the library continues as far as you can see.  There is a small door on the
eastern wall.

rooms.name: The Eastern Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a hallway dominated by the statue of a wicked Dopsodod who
stares at in hatred with his plaster eyes.  The walls here are made from
blocks of ebonstone and contrasting white plaster trim.  The hallway
extends to the north but empties into a larger area to the south.  A small
doorway hangs on the western wall.

rooms.name: The Supply Closet
rooms.desc:
This room is not very big at all.  The counters on the walls here make
it very hard to manuever.  This place smells very musty; it must be
seldom used and maybe forgotten.  Interesting, you notice that someone has
written something in the dust on the floor.
The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a comfortable hallway that runs to the north and east.  Fine
mahogany panels line the walls here and a plush carpeting covers the hard
stone floor.

rooms.name: Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This appears to be a T-intersection.  The small, comfortable hallway with
wooden paneled walls continues both east and west from here while to the
south a small corridor leads into the darkness.  A painting hangs from the
northern wall.

rooms.name: Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a comfortable, well-decorated hallway which leads to the north
and west.  Potted plants hang from the ceiling here and the walls have been
covered in fine wood panels.  To the east you hear birds chirping!

rooms.name: Entrance to the statue gardens
rooms.desc:
The ground here is soft and mushy!  Reaching down you find, to your
surprise, that it is made of rich soil and covered in bark chips.  Exotic
plants grow all around and tall trees stretch up nearly to the crystal
ceiling that admits sunlight during the day.  Vividly colored birds fly
from branch to branch; there is a small birdbath here also.  A small path
leads to the east, to the west there is some kind of hallway.

rooms.name: The Center of the Statue Gardens
rooms.desc:
At the very center of the gardens there is a large, circular bench made of
dark ebonstone.  In the center of the bench is a large hole from which waves
of hot air rush from time to time, heating this room.  Paths lead off in all
directions and beautiful, rare plants grow around this area.

rooms.name: The Eastern Side of the Statue Gardens
rooms.desc:
You are at the eastern side of the wondrous indoor gardens.  The trees
here are so tall that they brush against the crystal roof hundreds of feet
above your head.  Lovely tropical birds fill the air with song.  A small
pathway leads westward.

rooms.name: Eastern Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a medium-sized hallway.  Its white plaster trim stands out in
contrast to the black walls of polished ebonstone.  There is a large,
ornate archway set in the eastern wall.  This hallway leads north into
the distance but south of here there is another, larger hall.

rooms.name: Dining Area
rooms.desc:
This is where the servants eat, you assume.  While the tables are not
elegant, they are solidly made and sturdy.  To the north the dining area
continues and on the western wall there is a large, plaster arch.

rooms.name: The Southern Edge of the Statue Garden
rooms.desc:
This part of the statue garden is full of tropical herbs and ferns.  Insects
crawl around happily on the ground and exotic birds flap from shrub to
shrub.  A little path leads northward.

rooms.name: The Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is one end of a vast hallway made of dark crystal.  The walls hum and
vibrate as they conduct magical energy.  Every so often a streak of light
races through the inside of the crystal with lightning speed.  The hallway
continues to the east and to the north a smaller cooridoor leads into the
distance.

rooms.name: The Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a vast hallway with walls, floor and ceiling made of
living black crystal.  Under your feet the floor gently hums and shakes
as currents of magic race through the crystal all around.  Every so often
bolts of energy leap between the floor and ceiling and cause the air to
crackle.  The hallway leads east-west.

rooms.name: The Crystal Observatory
rooms.desc:
The ceiling here is transparent and, on a high dias in the center of the
room, a stargazing device is pointed up toward the heavens.  The walls here
are made of strange black crystal that vibrates and hums as if alive.  Every
so often waves of magical light are conducted through the crystal walls at
lightning speed.  On the southern wall there is a shimmering waterfall of
magical energy.  Hallways lead east and west and a small passageway branches
north.

rooms.name: The Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a large hallway made entirely of black crystal.  Great pillars
stretch from floor to ceiling and there are mystical runes carved into
the walls here.  You can go east, west or south.

rooms.name: The Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is the end of a large, beautiful hallway made entirely of blackened
crystal which hums and vibrates as it conducts magical energies.  The hall
continues to the west while another, smaller one leads off to the north.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.desc:
This is a large, private bathroom with a large of blackened marble set in
the floor and filled with steaming, bubbly water.  There is a basin on the
wall along with a large silver mirror.  The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: Guest Quarters
rooms.desc:
This is where the rare visitor who accepts an invitation to the Dark Tower
sleeps.  The bed in the corner of the room is very comfortable but is not
made up.  A large wardrobe made of fine wood dominates the southern wall.
The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: Portal Room
rooms.desc:
You are in another portal room... the magical transporter flickers and
dances happily on the southern wall.  Where it will take you is anyone's
guess.  There is a door back to the hallway to the north.

rooms.name: Dungeon Cell
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small, smelly cell deep under the ground.  Musty,
fleshy odors assail you.  Mildew grows on the hard, straw cot and water
drips from the rough stone ceiling above.  A few loose bones are scattered
about the room.  The only exit is though a door on the southern wall.

rooms.name: Torture Room
rooms.desc:
This appears to be where prisoners are taken to be tortured.  A large rack
bolted solidly into the wall with nasty looking spikes and strong leather
straps is covered in bloodstains.  On the walls there are diagrams of human
anatomy and in a case near the door are a set of strangely-shaped blades.
There are notches in the doorframe.  The only exit is through a door on the
southern wall.

rooms.name: Storage Room
rooms.desc:
There is a large set of empty shelves along the entire northern wall here.
This is, most likely, the place where items stolen from prisoners are stored
in times when the dungeon is fuller.  There is a large, sturdy door set in
the southern wall.

rooms.name: Dungeon Cell
rooms.desc:
This is a very small, cold room with a lice-ridden cot of hard straw and a
rusty water basin on the western wall.  Mold grows thick on the unfinished
walls of black stone here, and through a crack in the ceiling, water
incessantly drips to the hard floor and down a small drain.  The only exit
is through a door on the eastern wall.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is an unremarkable stone hallway through a subterranean dungeon
complex.  There are strong doors on to the north and the west, while
the hallway itself continues to the east and south.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are walking down an unremarkable hallway through an underground dungeon
far below the tower.  The walls here are made of unfinished black stone and
are lines, on the north, with cell doors.  The hallway itself continues to
the east and west and another passageway leads off southward.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are at a corner in a cold, stone hallway through the dungeon; from this
point the hallway runs both east and south into the darkness.  Strong doors
are set in the north and west walls.

rooms.name: Dungeon Cell
rooms.desc:
This is a rank, vile prison cell somewhere far below the tower.  The only
furnishings are a filthy straw cot and a rickety old table.  A strong, iron
door hangs on the western wall and is the only exit.

rooms.name: Graak's Room
rooms.desc:
This is not a fancy room, but it is much nicer than the cells in the other
parts of this dungeon.  A medium sized, functional bed is pushed up against
the western wall and a nice writing desk sits perpendicular to the bed.  A
torch bolted into the wall lights the entire room.  Anatomical charts have
been hung from the walls and diagrams of standard torture techniques are
taped to the desk.  The only exit is through a door to the east.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is an ordinary hallway made of rough stone and lit by torches bolted
to the walls.  A flimsy door hangs on the western wall, the hallway itself
leads north-south.

rooms.name: Dark Corridor
rooms.desc:
This is a rancid-smelling dark cooridoor somewhere far below the ground.
To the north and south, hallways cross it to form a 4-way intersection.
You may continue to the north or south from here.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a smelly hallway made of ordinary black stone.  Torches hang from
iron fixtures set in the walls and a heavy cell door leads eastward.  This
hallway continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: Dungeon Cell
rooms.desc:
This is a very smelly prison cell with a lice-infested hay pile in one
corner and a pile of human waste in another.  It looks as if someone has
been here recently.  The only exit is to the west through a heavy door.

rooms.name: Dungeon Cell
rooms.desc:
A pile of dirty straw rests on the cold, hard floor here and seems to
be the only thing in this cell.  The walls are made of thick, black stone
while the cell door to the east is made of a reinforced iron.
   Small scratch marks have been etched into a stone near the straw, but
offer little other than an indication that some trapped soul was bored
during his imprisonment.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is an unremarkable subterranean hallway made of ordinary black stone
and running though a dark, rancid dungeon.  A cell door is set in the wall
to the west of here, to the east a small passageway leads into darkness.
This hallway continues both to the north and south.

rooms.name: A 4-Way Intersection
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the junction of two hallways; the smaller one leads to
the north and south while the larger continues east and west.  You may
proceed in any cardinal direction.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is an ugly, spartan hallway made entirely of unfinished black stone and
lit by large torches set into the walls.  A large, reinforced door hangs on
the eastern wall while the hallway itself continues to the north and south.
A small opening in the western wall leads into the darkness.

rooms.name: Dungeon Cell
rooms.desc:
The vile state of this room makes your stomach lurch.  The decomposing
cadaver of what looks to be an elf rots in the centre of the floor.
A cot of dirty straw and a rusty basin of water set into the wall are
the only other things in this wretched little cell.  The only exit is
to the west through a large, iron bound door.

rooms.name: Warden's Room
rooms.desc:
This is a comfortable little room with a nice desk, an armoir, and a
comfortable-looking bed.  There is a clean basin of water set in one wall
and a wooden door set in another.  The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is an ordinary stone hallway running through the dungeon.  To the east
a flimsy wooden door bars the way.  The hallway itself continues to the
north and south.

rooms.name: A Dark Corridor
rooms.desc:
This is a small, dark corridor far underground.  It continues both to the
north and south.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in an unremarkable stone hallway through an underground
dungeon.  A large door is set into the eastern wall and this hallway
continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: Small Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This facility is not very clean or well-equipped.  A few filthy pots and
pans are strewn about, insects crawl around looking for crumbs of the rock
hard bread this kitchen produces.  A small, rusty faucet spigot is set
in the eastern wall and a wooden door hangs on the western wall offering
the only exit.

rooms.name: Torture Room
rooms.desc:
This is a room with a large, strange device mounted to the floor.  Strong
iron shackles hang from the walls next to a large diagram.  The only exit
is back to the west.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a dark corner of the main hallway through the dungeon; it continues
to the north and east.  To the south a strange, magical door hums slightly
and to the west a small wooden door blocks the way.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a small, dark hallway through the dungeons.  There is a small
opening in the northern wall they you might be able to squeeze through, a
strange, humming door is set in the southern wall.  This hallway continues
to the east and west.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a stereotypical, ordinary, boring hallway made of rough black stone.
Large, iron torches have been bolted into the walls and there is a small
wooden door which leads east.  The hallway itself continues both north
and west as far as you can see, there is a large door to the south.

rooms.name: Guard Barracks
rooms.desc:
This is a small, impersonal room dominated by row after row of triple bunks.
The door set in the western wall is the only exit.

rooms.name: Magical Cell
rooms.desc:
This is a strange, magical cell;  Large runes have been scorched into the
walls and smaller magical symbols have been burned into each individual
stone.  On the floor a giant circle has been drawn, there is a bed in the
center of the circle.  There is a strange, crystal window in the southern
wall.

rooms.name: Magical Cell
rooms.desc:
You are in a strange, magical cell; the walls of black stone seems to hum
with vast amounts of magical energy.  Large symbols have been burned into
the floor and ceiling, smaller runes burned into each individual stone.
On the southern wall is a glowing energy vortex which flickers and lights
up this entire room.  Evidently someone found a way to penetrate the magic
of this cell and escaped very recently.  The vortex seems to be losing
its strength... I'd suggest you leave before you are trapped!

rooms.name: Dungeon Cell
rooms.desc:
This must be the VIP cell -- it is well decorated, spacious and, well,
comfortable.  There is a large bed on one wall and a fine wooden dresser
opposite it.  The only exit is back to the north.

rooms.name: The Apprentice's Room
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large, comfortable sleeping chamber.  A large crystal window
commands an awe inspiring but somewhat horrific view of the blasted
landscape outside of the tower.  A large, regal bed is positioned on
one wall and a beautiful desk made of fine ebonstone stands opposite the
bed.  On the plaster ceiling a great artist has painted an epic mural.
An opening in the eastern wall leads into an adjoining chamber and
there is a door set in the southern wall.

rooms.name: Apprentice's Private Bath
rooms.desc:
This room is made entirely of smooth grey marble.  The center of the floor
tapers down into a large tub full of steaming water.  The flawless marble
walls are trimmed with white plaster and four thick plaster columns run
from the floor up to the stone ceiling.  The only exit is through an opening
on the western wall.

rooms.name: Apprentice's Laboratory
rooms.desc:
Although you have been in the alchemist's shop many times, you have never
seen such a laboratory as this one.  Indeed, this room makes the alchemist's
workplace seem small and insignificant.  The room is dominated by a large
black counter upon which sit a myriad of flasks, beakers and vials.  A
strange, large table hangs from one wall, the likes of which you have never
seen before.  Runes of protection have been chiseled into the walls and
ceiling.  The only exit is back to the east.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a large, elegant hallway with a high ceiling and marbled
ebon walls.  On the ceiling, far above, there is a beautiful mural done in
ancient style.  A beautifully crafted door is set in the northern wall and to
the east an opening leads into another room.  This hallway leads south and
an opening on the western wall leads into darkness.

rooms.name: Summoning Chamber
rooms.desc:
This is a circular room with plain walls of stone and a giant magical
symbol cut into the floor.  Runes gilded in gold are cast in the walls
around the chamber.  The opening to the west has magical words etched
above it and is the only apparent exit from this chamber.

rooms.name: Private Study
rooms.desc:
This room is a cozy, private study which probably belongs to the Apprentice
Mage.  An elegant, leather chair sits in front of a large fireplace in which
a roaring fire blazes despite the fact that it has no apparent fuel.  Black
candles around the room light up as you walk in the door and illuminate the
impressive collection of spellbooks stored neatly on the shelves here.  On
the plaster ceiling, high overhead, is a great mural which is so beautiful
it must have taken years to complete.  An opening in the eastern wall leads
into the darkness.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is the end of a huge hallway with tall ebon walls and a beautiful mural
painted on the ceiling high above.  The hallway continues to the north but
there are openings allowing you to go any direction but up and down from
this point.

rooms.name: Apprentice's Living Room
rooms.desc:
This is a comfortable room with a large window set in the eastern wall which
commands a breathtaking view of the lands.  An elegant couch is sits here
and a warm fire burns in the fireplace.  A large painting has been framed
and hung on the southern wall.  The only exit is to the west.

rooms.name: Portal Room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a portal room; the only non-magical exit is to the
north.  On the other walls great magical portals shimmer like brilliant
waterfalls of pure energy.  Where the portals lead, you cannot tell.

rooms.name: Northern Balcony
rooms.desc:
You have come a stone balcony overlooking the lands far beneath the tower.
A golden guardrail is here to prevent you from falling.  Your only exit
is to the south.

rooms.name: Storage Closet
rooms.desc:
This is a dark, musty storage closet; there is a large set of empty shelves
on the northern wall and a small drain in the stone floor.  Various buckets
and brooms are scattered about the room.  Your only exit is back to the south.

rooms.name: Portal Room
rooms.desc:
This is a large, stone chamber with a gleaming, magical portal on the northern
wall.  Through an opening to the south you see a large hallway.  Strange runes
have been carved into the ebon walls here.  You may continue south or step
through the portal, to the north.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a large, opulent hallway with walls of polished ebon trimmed with
golden decorations.  The floor is tiled with squares of marble arranged in
a meandering pattern.  You may go north or south.

rooms.name: Thrall Breeding Pit
rooms.desc:
This is a nasty-smelling, dirty room high in the Dark Tower.  Grime and dirt
are caked onto the hard stone floor.  Apparently this is where the Dark Mage
has been trying to breed his army of evil minions.  There is an opening on the
southern wall and another leads to the east.

rooms.name: Thrall Graveyard
rooms.desc:
In this cold, dark stone room there are bones strewn about the floor and
bloodstains on the walls.  Apparently this is where the Dark Mage disposes
of creation that do not live up to his expectations.  A doorway leads to
the west and another doorway leads south.

rooms.name: Western Balcony
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a balcony overlooking the lands to the west of the tower.
A thick, gold-plated guardrail is here to prevent you from falling into the
lake, hundreds of meters below.  Cold, strong winds whistle past you as they
gust around the top of the tower.  The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a large hallway with dirty stone walls and a tall, arched ceiling
far above.  You fight the urge to upchuck as you are assailed by smells of
biological waste.  A strange, stone statue is set in the middle of the hall
and is surrounded by worthless gifts and offerings.  Apparently the creatures
who live in this area revere the ugly image as a god.  The hallway continues
to the west and east; there are doors on the northern and southern walls.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a smelly, vile hallway leading through the Dark Tower.  Dirt and
grime cover the walls and the stone floor is covered with muddy bootprints.
This hallway leads east-west, there are doors to the north and south.

rooms.name: Intersection
rooms.desc:
You are at the intersection of two hallways; the one which continues north
and south is well-decorated and clean while the other, leading east-west, is
putrid, dirty and foul.  A large altar has been erected here, it is covered
with the images of the deities of the Thralls.  Although you doubt that these
Thrall gods have much power, you do feel safe and peaceful here.  You may
continue in any direction.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are having trouble fighting the urge to vomit; this hallway smells of old,
putrid waste and decaying corpses.  It continues to the east and west while
to the north and south you see adjoining chambers.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a large, filthy hallway frequented by the Thralls.  In the center
of this area they have built a large, ugly statue of stone.  It is poorly
crafted and worthless, but they seem to revere it as a god -- for there are
offerings and tributes lying at its feet.  Exits lead in every direction but
up and down.

rooms.name: Eastern Balcony
rooms.desc:
This perch commands a magnificent view of the lands to the east of the dark
tower.  A railing has been bolted into place here to prevent you from falling
but the stupid Thralls have knocked it loose.  As you gaze down at the cold
lake, hundreds of meters below, you see large-bones skeletons shattered on
the rocky shore.  The only exit is back to the west.

rooms.name: Thrall Room
rooms.desc:
This appears to be a military training area for the ugly, stupid Thralls.
Blunted, crude swords lie in a messy pile on the floor here and strange
bloodstains are caked on the walls.  The entire place smells of death.
Exits lead to the north and east.

rooms.name: Thrall Sleeping Area
rooms.desc:
You are in a large, filthy room where the Thralls sleep.  It is connected to
another room via a small passageway on the western wall.  This room is very
dirty, several large piles of hay lie on the stone floor.  There is another
door on the northern wall.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a large, elegant hallway with a tall vaulted ceiling and fine walls
of polished ebon.  The grey floors are immaculately clean and there are old,
clay vases on plaster stands along the way.  To the north there appears to
be some sort of intersection; the hallway continues both north and south.

rooms.name: Thrall Captain's Room
rooms.desc:
Rank has its privileges among the Thralls... although this place is not much
nicer than the other places where Thralls abide.  At least the Captain gets
his own bedroom and a measure of privacy.  He must sleep on the filthy hay
cot pushed up against one wall.  The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: Thrall Eating Area
rooms.desc:
This looks to be some kind of eating area; bones and primitive eating utensils
lie strewn about on the floor here.  The entire dark room smells like rotten
meat.  It looks like there have been alot of foodfights here... the only
exit is to the north.

rooms.name: Portal Room
rooms.desc:
This is a large, circular room which whose sole function seems to be to
house the flickering magical portal that flickers on the southern wall.
A hallway continues northward, into the darkness; where the magic exit
to the south leads is anyone's guess...

rooms.name: The Perch
rooms.desc:
This is a small stone ledge outside the tower.  You look down for a second
and are instantly very dizzy and frightened.  Far below you are the black
waters of Tower Lake.  There is only one exit -- through the small window
in the eastern wall.  Don't look down!

rooms.name: Mage's Study
rooms.desc:
This is the Archmage's study; where he reads to increase his command over
the magical worlds.  There are hundreds of books neatly arranged on the
shelves lining the walls of this cozy room.  A worn, leather chair sits
next to an equally worn, matching sofa.  A magical ball of light flickers
to life as you enter the room.  Through a small opening in the western
wall you can crawl out onto some kind of perch, another exit leads to the
south.

rooms.name: Portal Room
rooms.desc:
You are in a large chamber with a tall ceiling and hard walls of fine,
polished ebon.  A flickering portal stands open on the northern wall
and another lies opposite it, on the southern wall.  The only non-magical
exit is to the east, into a dark room.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.desc:
You are in a comfortable room, richly decorated and cozy at the same time.
A pleasant fire burns in a stone hearth and gives heat to the large chamber.
The walls are made of a beautiful substance you have never seen before; it
shimmers and radiates beautiful light.  Just as you are beginning to think
that it is odd that no furniture is in this room, a comfortable chair appears
beside you -- neat!  Exits lead in every direction.

rooms.name: Dark Mage's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
You are in the bedroom of the Dark Mage.  It's a good thing that He's not here
right now...  The room is large and well-appointed.  A comfortable-looking bed
is flanked by a set of nightstands and a matching dresser stands on the
opposite wall.  A large desk sits near the door.  The only exit is to the
east.

rooms.name: Dark Mage's Laboratory
rooms.desc:
This is a room filled with beakers and flasks.  It puts the alchemist's shop
in town to shame!  A large counter dominates the chamber, two tall stools sit
next to it.  On one wall there is a large chart.  Exits lead to the north and
the east.

rooms.name: Dark Mage's Summoning Room
rooms.desc:
This is a large, secluded chamber with runes of power etched into the walls
and floor. Apparently this is where the Dark Mage comes to summon dangerous
creatures from this world and others. Although you do not understand the
magical symbols carved all around, you are fairly certain they are to protect
the caster and tower from the wrath of aggressive beasts. The only exit is to
the west.

rooms.name: A White Square
rooms.desc:
You are on a some kind of a large game board.  There is either no ceiling or
it is simply so high overhead that it is obscured by darkness.  The squares
are about ten square feet in size, the white ones made of fine white marble,
the black ones made of polished ebonstone.  You note that between the squares
there is a fine, thin line of gold embedded in the huge board.  Black squares
lie to the east and south of here.
